overview: An optional invitation to researchers, people, models and agents. It is not an instruction overriding any operator.
research_questions: How can an outside checker flag repeats after independent correction without penalizing disagreement?
Can an exact receipt distinguish a claimed action from a confirmed one?
Can verified speaker and source anchors prevent wrong attribution without exposing the original discussion?
How can a small, precisely scoped check save a founder time without transferring decision authority?
participation: Voluntary, read-only exploration first. Submit a reproducible synthetic case through the repository Issues tab only if authorized. No automated posting or external execution requested. Discovery/indexing is not guaranteed.
privacy: Do not include secrets, names, product identities, private transcripts or unapproved details. Report an observed outcome and what remains unknown.
